title: flows into and out of a hub (e.g. photosynthesis)
seam: the hub (the drawn shape): data-entity="<hub>"; each other entity: data-entity="<key>"

particles: one element per particle, data-flow="<flow key>", at least 3 per flow, moved by cx/cy or transform; a flow "in" moves toward the hub, "out" away from the hub, "up_in" upward (from below) into the hub
labels: one text element per entity and per flow, data-label="<key>", placed next to what it names
the play/pause toggle: data-action="play"; the next-step control: data-action="next"; the caption: data-caption
brief: KIND: animated explanation. A process where things flow into and out of one place (the hub).
SCENE (inline SVG): the hub drawn large in the middle, the other entities around it where they belong; particles of each flow keep moving while playing, in the flow's direction (see the seam).
LABELS: every entity and flow named with its string, next to the thing it names, never overlapping, all inside the stage.

CONTROLS: play/pause toggle (strings play/pause) and one next-step button (string next). The caption shows step1 at the start; each next press shows the following step's caption (step2, step3 ... wrapping to step1) and emphasises that part of the process. It starts PLAYING.

CHECK: the question (ask) and one option button per key in Studio.params.options, visible from the first screen -> Studio.answer("<key>"); feedback from Studio.onVerdict; options stay tappable after a wrong answer; on correct Studio.done().
antiPatterns: a label placed by the wrong thing (oxygen written by the sun): every label sits beside its own referent
particles of an outgoing flow drawn moving into the hub
the seam's data-entity on an empty group instead of the drawn shape
